name: oh-my-hermes
description: All in one plugin for Hermes Agent ⚚ the coding intelligence, a long-term memory system and model optimized workflow packages
one_liner: An add-on pack for an AI coding assistant that gives it a long-term memory and pre-optimized workflows, so it remembers your project instead of starting fresh every session.
buyer: An indie developer or small dev team frustrated that their AI coding assistant forgets project context between sessions.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer keeps a consistent AI pairing partner across a months-long client project without re-explaining context.
A dev-tools startup bundles it into a paid 'AI memory layer' add-on for an existing coding-agent product.
A coding bootcamp packages it as part of a premium AI-assisted curriculum module.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted, managed memory-sync backend as a paid add-on
Sell premium pre-built workflow packs on top of the free core

steal_this: Package a hosted 'memory as a service' backend for it this weekend, with a free tier to build a user base first.
